pt.titulo: Economic optimization of irrigation decisions using water productivity for crop selection in western Transdanubia
pt.resumo_biocultura: Despite decades of research on irrigation efficiency and water productivity, the integration of market volatility into irrigation decision-support models remains limited. pt.titulo: Solar power helps Amazon communities ditch diesel and prepare for El Niño drought
pt.resumo_biocultura: SANTAREM, Brazil (AP) — Off-grid solar power is spreading across Brazil’s Amazon, helping remote communities prepare for severe drought while replacing costly, polluting diesel generators.
